payload.title: Receive real publication predictions through the durable central command path
payload.description:
As a publication operator, I want the central lab to classify shared discoveries through its guarded worker, so that publications reuse one multi-output request without bypassing original human authority.

Feature: Hosted publication predictions
  Scenario: Share one engine across publication outputs
    Given a verified account session and configured run with four distinct publication outputs
    And live execution and a bounded provider factory are explicitly configured
    When the same frozen source revision is requested for each publication
    Then durable authorized jobs execute the existing SDK over canonical S3 storage
    And all publication projections share one native decision and one provider request
    And no label seed or training operation occurs
  Scenario: Preserve queue and scope boundaries
    Given a queued publication request with original-session provenance
    When membership identity run binding or publication binding changes before worker execution
    Then no provider dispatch occurs
    And an uncertain running claim is not automatically replayed
  Scenario: Wait for a real prediction receipt
    Given the host accepted a pending command
    When the client waits for completion
    Then it polls only a bounded same-origin receipt path
    And pending timeout or failed delivery is not reported as a prediction
  Scenario: Keep activation explicit
    Given provider or publication deployment configuration is missing
    When the service starts or an unauthorized publication is requested
    Then it fails closed without new grants infrastructure or a local fallback
